use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
#[test]
fn powers_match_java_coefficients_and_scales() {
    let results = evaluate(&BTreeMap::new()).unwrap();
    let mut count = 0;
    for line in include_str!("power_vectors.tsv").lines() {
        let c: Vec<_> = line.split('\t').collect();
        assert_eq!(
            results[&("urn:rust-proof:powers", c[0])],
            Value::Number {
                coefficient: c[1].into(),
                scale: c[2].parse().unwrap()
            },
            "{}",
            c[0]
        );
        count += 1;
    }
    assert_eq!(count, 152);
}
